Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the run chase as the umpires make their way out to the middle. The Pakistan players are in a huddle at the boundary line before taking their respective positions on the field. Kushal Bhurtel and Aasif Sheikh will open the inning for Nepal and will want to get a good start here. Shaheen Afridi has the new ball in his hand and is ready to begin proceedings. Let's go...
... THE RUN CHASE ...

With Nepal facing the task of chasing down 343 runs in their 50 overs, the stage is set for an enthralling chase. Stay tuned as the action unfolds, and the pursuit of this challenging target commences.

Iftikhar Ahmed is up for a chat. He says that his game plan was to bat deep and get used to the pitch. He adds that Babar Azam is a very big player and batting alongside him is very fun and the rotation of strike was the key to their partnership. He mentions that the ball was gripping on the pitch and it got better over time.

Nepal's bowling attack opened the innings with gusto, claiming both Pakistani openers through well-executed catches and sharp run-outs. However, Babar and Rizwan crafted a partnership to counter the early blows, propelling their team's efforts. Yet, Nepal's resilience paid off with a brilliant runout dismissing Rizwan for 44, followed by another quick wicket in the form of Agha Salman. By the 25th over, Nepal had limited Pakistan to 115 for 4 wickets, seemingly putting them on the backfoot. However, the latter half of Nepal's fielding performance turned out to be their undoing, marked by numerous misfields and dropped catches. These lapses enabled Babar and his team to amass a substantial total.

The first clash of the Asia Cup 2023 has concluded with Pakistan setting an imposing target of 343 runs on the scoreboard, having lost 6 wickets in their allocated 50 overs. Babar Azam, ever the anchor, showcased his brilliance once again by notching up an impressive 151 runs off 131 balls, securing his second ODI score of 150+. Alongside him, Iftikhar Ahmed stunned with a remarkable knock of 109 off just 71 balls, claiming his maiden ODI century. The duo orchestrated a stellar partnership of 214 runs, steering Pakistan towards a formidable total on a wicket that retained its batting-friendly characteristics.

It will be the national anthem of Nepal first followed by Pakistan's national anthem. Some live performances for the crowd now as we build-up towards the game.

Rohit Paudel, the captain of Nepal mentions that everyone is happy as this team is playing for the first time in the Asia Cup. He claims that the conditions back home are similar to that in Pakistan. He ends by mentioning his bowling combination.

Babar Azam, the skipper of Pakistan says that he wants to bat first as the pitch looks shiny and flat. Mentions that they were confident coming into this match so they named their playing 11 the previous night. Claims that they will enjoy the game and play good cricket.

Nepal have made it to the Asia Cup for the first time and it is a massive achievement for a small nation which is situated in the mountainous regions of Asia. They pegged a strong United Arab Emirates side back in the ACC Men’s Premier Cup final to make it to this tournament and put on strong batting performances throughout the competition. They have a strong top four and most of the responsibility falls on them to score a chunk of the runs. Like most subcontinent teams, Nepal have also reached the world stage courtesy of their spin attack and they will want to build their bowling attack around some quality all-rounders in their set-up. Will they be able to match against the number 1 ODI side in the world and pull off an unlikely win? Or will Pakistan continue their winning momentum? We will find out soon. Stay tuned as we bring you the toss and team updates.

Pakistan come into this competition as the number one side having whitewashed Afghanistan 3-0 in the recently concluded series. They will want to prove their credentials by clinching this trophy and look to go into the World Cup as one of the favourites with matches being played in subcontinent conditions. They have a powerful lineup and the depth in their batting order allows them to be in the game right till the end. Their strength has historically been their pace bowling unit and with some talented bowlers in their lineup, the trend seems to be continuing. Their dependence on pace does reduce the options they have in the spin bowling department and it could be a dangerous ploy in conditions that are much more suited to the slower bowlers. They will know that this fixture could be tricky but are expected to trounce through this one.

This is a great opportunity for all teams to finalize their team plans and look for their best playing eleven in the buildup to the mega event as this tournament will be played in the 50-over format. The first game sees the original hosts Pakistan lock horns against Nepal at the Multan Cricket Stadium and both teams will be eager to get off to a good start.  Pakistan are clear favorites going into this tie but Nepal have shown their ability in recent times and if they play at their best, we could have an upset on the cards.

The road to becoming Asian champions has arrived as we approach the first match of the Asia Cup 2023. The hosts, Pakistan will lock horns with Nepal at the Multan cricket stadium in Pakistan. Pakistan is arriving into this series on a very positive note. They became the number 1 ODI team after beating Afghanistan 3-0 in their bilateral series held in Sri Lanka. They have the home advantage for most of their matches which is a big plus point for them. Led by Babar Azam, this squad has performed exceptionally well in all formats of the game. Their opening pair of Fakhar Zaman and Imam-ul-Haq are very dependable and provide the team with strong starts. Imam was the man of the series against Afghanistan and he is coming into the Asia Cup in a very good form. Babar Azam and Mohammad Rizwan stabilize the innings in the middle stages and Shadab Khan along with Agha Salman and Mohammad Nawaz give the team a very explosive end. Their bowling unit has a very strong pace attack consisting of Naseem Shah and Shaheen Afridi leading with the new ball. Shadab Khan and Usama Mir handle the spin attack and trouble the batters in the middle stages. They will look to win their first match and start the tournament with a win. Nepal, on the other hand, has qualified for the Asia Cup for the first time. They qualified through the ACC Men’s Premiere Cup by winning 3 out of their 4 league stage matches. Under the captaincy of Rohit Paudel, they defeated UAE in the finals and secured their place in the Asia Cup. They have been placed in Group A along with India and Pakistan. They have only played 57 ODIs yet winning 30 out of them. Rohit will lead the squad in this tournament with Dipendra Singh Airee being the deputy. Rohit Paudel, Kushal Bhurtel, Aasif Sheikh, and Aarif Sheikh are the experienced batters in the team and everyone will have high expectations from them to perform and put some runs on the board. Dipendra will handle the innings in the middle stages. He is also their best all-rounder. Sandeep Lamichhane is a very well-known name in international cricket and also the most prominent bowler for Nepal. He along with Karan KC and Sompal Kami will take the bowling attack to the opposition. This match is a huge opportunity for Nepal to win against a very strong opponent and gain a significant advantage to qualify for the Super 4 stage. This is expected to be an exciting start to the tournament as the number 1 ODI team faces off against the underdogs. The weather looks sunny for the match and we hope to see a full game of cricket being played. Who do you think will come out victorious?
